items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Higgins said - He called me acki, that’s brother... 'let’s stop datin’ and go steady.' ... 'we have to keep working on this music.' ... 'I didn’t say I'd be there, but I'll always be with you.'

ctx.x: And so Higgins and I - we’d play together in that formation from time to time, and then I remember Higgins said - He called me acki, that’s brother. He said, “Acki, let’s stop datin’ and go steady.” [Laughs] You know.
